name: GET /get
notes: Expect HTTP 200 and a JSON response with the request URL and headers.

name: HEAD /get
notes: Verify the response status and headers. A HEAD response has no body.

name: OPTIONS /get
notes: Inspect the Allow response header to see which methods the endpoint advertises.

name: POST /post · Echo body
notes: Send the JSON body and verify that the response echoes it under json.

name: PUT /put · Echo body
notes: Verify that httpbin parses the JSON body sent with PUT.

name: PATCH /patch · Echo body
notes: Verify that the JSON response echoes enabled as false.

name: DELETE /delete · Echo request
notes: Inspect the echoed request metadata for the DELETE call.

name: GET /headers · Request headers
notes:
Add a header such as X-Workbench: example in the editor, then send.
Check the returned headers for its name and value.

name: Set demo cookie
notes: Run the httpbin Cookie Session group. This first step returns a 302 response and sets flowie=workbench for the next request.

name: Read demo cookie
notes: The JSON response should show cookies.flowie as workbench.

name: GET /json · JSON response
notes: Inspect the sample JSON returned by httpbin.

name: GET /status/204 · No Content
notes: Expect HTTP 204 with an empty response body.

name: GET /status/404 · Not Found
notes: Expect HTTP 404. Run this request on its own to inspect the response, or as a step to check that Run Collection stops at a client error.

name: GET /status/500 · Server Error
notes: Expect HTTP 500. Run this request on its own to inspect the response, or as a step to check that Run Collection stops at a server error.

name: GET /relative-redirect/1 · Redirect
notes: Inspect the 3xx response and its Location header for the next URL.

name: GET /delay/1 · Delayed response
notes: Expect the server to wait about one second before responding. Network time adds to the total.
